decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 1st March 2005, the erection of single-storey rear/side extension with flat roof, to measure 3.9m depth x 6.65m width x 3.1m maximum height is not lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - INFROMATIVE: The dwelling is part of a terrace development and as such the limit for extensions is 50 cubic metres or 10% of the original dwelling, whichever is the greater. The garage does not appear to be original and therefore contributes to the volume calculations under the Permitted Development Order. If you are able to provide evidence that the garage was built at the time as the house or before July 1st 1948 you should resubmit your lawful development certificate application including this evidence and the Council will reconsider the case. In such cases, the burden of proof lies with the applicant and not the Council. Otherwise the garage would need to be demolished, prior to application being made, and the extension reduced to meet the Permitted Development requirements. Alternatively, a Planning Application would need to be made to proceed with this design.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear/side extension to house.
